test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: All 30 students of a class are standing in a straight line facing north. Amit is 12th from the left end of the line. What will be his position from the right end of the line?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Position of Amit from the left = 12th

Total number of students = 30

Position of Amit from the right = Total number of students - Position of Amit from the left + 1

= 30 - 12 + 1

= 19

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
